name: smevals
tagline: A framework for running evals against small (and large) models
description: smevals is an evaluation framework for running evals against small models — and large ones too. It gives model teams a structured way to measure quality across a battery of tasks, with the small-model focus reflecting the industry shift toward compact, on-device, and edge models where eval rigor matters even more because there is less headroom for error.
highlights: Evals designed for small models without sacrificing large-model support
Framework approach makes evals repeatable and comparable
From Prime Radiant, focused on practical model quality measurement
curatorNote: Small models are eating the edge, but most eval tooling still targets frontier models. smevals fills the gap with a framework built for the compact-model era.
